name: Ajj Aakhaan Waris Shah Nu
abstract: An elegy to the 18th-century Punjabi poet Waris Shah, expressing the anguish of the Partition of 1947.

content.original:
Ajj aakhaan Waris Shah nu, kiton kabraan vichon bol,
Te ajj kitab-e-ishq da koi agla varka phol.
content.translation:
Today, I call Waris Shah, “Speak from your grave,”
And turn, today, the book of love’s next affectionate page.

source.name: Academy of the Punjab in North America
